name: spinner-moods
description: Colors and animates the spinner by what Claude is doing, with themes, palettes, and little reactions

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The icons the spinner animates: classic ✢ ◐ ◇, sparkle ⋆ ✧ ✦, hearts ♡ ♥, moon ◔ ◑ ◕, geometric ◧ ▲ ◆.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Colors for thinking, tools, and everything else: classic, pastel, neon, cozy, or mono (your terminal's own text color).

details.title: Details
details.description: What follows the word: full (time, tokens, effort), time only, or minimal (nothing).

reactions.title: Reactions
reactions.description: Get flustered for a few seconds after a failed tool call, and sleepy when nothing has happened for a minute.
